series.name: The Teacher's Diary
series.tagline: Ek teacher ki sabse badi safalta yeh nahi ki uske bacche successful hue. Yeh hai ki unhone usse phone karna band nahi kiya.
series.concept: A retired school teacher — Sharma Sir — has died. His daughter finds his diary spanning 20+ years of notes on 10 students he tutored at his modest 2BHK in a tier-2 Indian city. The diary reveals his perspective — his pride, worry, bias, mistakes. Each episode is a diary entry about one student or event, narrated in Sharma Sir's voice. He was kind but imperfect — he had favorites, misjudged kids, and was wrong sometimes. The series IS the diary.

episodes.title: The Diary

slides.text: Papa ka kamra saaf karte hue ek diary mili. Purani. Peeli padhi hui. Cover pe kuch nahi likha. Andar pehle page pe unki handwriting — woh handwriting jo maine bachpan se dekhi hai.
Pehle page pe likha tha — '10 bacche. 2 ghante. 1 kamra. Yeh meri duniya thi.'
20 saal tak, roz shaam 5 se 7, mere ghar mein 10 bacche aate the. Zameen pe baithte the. Maine Math aur Science padhaya. Par shayad Maine life bhi padha di. Ya shayad unhone mujhe padha diya.

Aman — ameer baap ka laadla. Priya — sabse tez. Raju — sabse dhheema, par sabse achha. Neha — padhna nahi chahti thi. Vikram — akela tha. Sonal — perfect thi. Deepak — hasata tha. Ananya — ladti thi. Rahul — sabse normal. Kabir — sabse shareef.
Yeh diary kisi aur ke liye nahi thi. Yeh Papa ki apni thi. Apne bacchon ke baare mein — woh bacche jo unke the bhi, aur nahi bhi the. Aur isme sab likha hai. Pyaar bhi. Galtiyan bhi.
Main aapko woh diary sunane ja rahi hoon. Ek ek page. Ek ek bachcha. 20 saal ki kahani. Sharma Sir ke shabdon mein — jaise unhone dekha, samjha, aur galat bhi samjha.

episodes.synopsis: Sharma Sir's daughter finds the diary while cleaning his room after his death. She opens the first page and reads his words. We meet the setup — 10 kids, 1 room, 20 years of notes.
episodes.caption: A father who wasn't your father. A teacher who wasn't just a teacher. His diary was never meant to be read. But it's the most honest thing his students will ever hear. This is The Teacher's Diary. Follow for every page.

episodes.title: The First Day

slides.text: 5 June 2002. Aaj pehla din tha. 10 bacche aaye. Ghar mein itni awaazein pehli baar aayi. Biwi ne kaha — 'Itne bacche? Kamra chhota hai.' Maine kaha — 'Kamra bada ho jayega.'
Aman sabse pehle aaya. Driver chhod ke gaya. Naye joote the. Kamre mein aake bola — 'Sir, fan toh chalao.' Isko pehle din se attitude hai. Ameer baap ke bacche aise hi hote hain.

slides.section: The Quiet One and The Slow One
slides.text: Priya apni maa ke saath aayi. Maa ne kaha — 'Sir, yeh bahut tez hai. Top karegi.' Ladki ne kuch nahi bola. Seedha baith gayi, kitaab nikaal li. Raju akela aaya. Kapde purane the. Baith gaya corner mein. Kisi ne baat nahi ki usse.

Deepak ne aate hi ek joke maara. Sab hase. Yeh padhega nahi, par kamre mein zinda rakhega sabko. Neha drawing kar rahi thi copy mein — tuition mein drawing? Vikram seedha baitha tha jaise parade ground ho. Sonal ne mujhe 'Good evening Sir' bola. Baki kisi ne nahi bola.

Rahul — average ladka. Na tez, na slow. Par sabse pehle Raju ke paas gaya aur bola — 'Yahan baith, idhar fan aata hai.' Kabir chup tha. Kisi ne usse kuch kaha — 'Tu yahan padhta hai?' Matlab samajh gaya main. Chhota sheher. Bade biases.

Pehle din maine kuch nahi padhaya. Bas sabko apna naam bolne ko kaha. Aur ek sawaal — 'Bade hoke kya banna hai?' Aman bola — 'Papa jaisa. Rich.' Priya boli — 'Engineer.' Raju bola — 'Pata nahi.' Maine socha — yeh sabse honest jawab tha.

Aaj ka observation: Priya mein potential hai. Raju mushkil hoga. Aman ko todna padega. Ananya gussa bahut karti hai. Kabir pe dhyan dena padega. Rahul? Kuch special nahi. Average. (20 saal baad yeh line padhke mujhe bahut taklif hogi.)

episodes.synopsis: Diary entry from 5 June 2002 — the day tuition started. 10 kids walk into Sharma Sir's living room. First impressions. His biases are already forming.
episodes.caption: 10 kids. 1 room. And a teacher who thought he could read them all in 5 minutes. He was right about some. Dead wrong about others. The diary doesn't lie — even about the teacher himself.

episodes.title: The Exam

slides.text: February 2004. Board exams ek mahine mein. 10 bacche, 10 tarah ka darr. Kuch ko darr hai fail hone ka. Kuch ko darr hai topper na ban paane ka. Aur kuch ko darr hi nahi hai — yeh sabse zyada darr wali baat hai.

Priya din mein 14 ghante padh rahi hai. Uski maa ne phone kiya — 'Sir, khaana nahi khaati. Raat ko neend nahi aati.' Yeh ladki topper banega, par iske andar kuch toot raha hai. Aman — ek baar bhi book nahi kholi. Bola — 'Sir, papa donation de denge.'

Raju aaj roya. Bola — 'Sir, mujhe kuch nahi aata. Maa bahut mehnat karti hai. Agar fail ho gaya toh?' Maine usse apne paas baithaya. Bola — 'Raju, tera fail hona possible hai. Par teri mehnat fake nahi hai. Aur tera dil — woh koi exam nahi maap sakta.' Par kya yeh kaafi hai?

Deepak — isse marks nahi aayenge. Par aaj isne Raju ko 2 ghante baithke Trigonometry samjhaya. Galat samjhaya — par pyaar se samjhaya. Kabir ne ek poem likhi exams ke baare mein. Maine kaha — 'Exam mein poem nahi aayegi.' Usne kaha — 'Sir, yeh exam ke liye nahi. Darr ke liye.' Main chup ho gaya.

Exam se ek raat pehle, 9 bacchon ne phone kiya. Sirf Rahul ne nahi kiya. Aman ne poocha — 'Sir, kya aayega?' Priya ne poocha — 'Sir, kaafi hai na?' Raju ne poocha — 'Sir, maa ko kya bolunga?' Sonal ne poocha — 'Sir, 95 se kam aaye toh?' Vikram ne kaha — 'Sir, tension mat lo. Sab hoga.' Vikram 16 saal ka tha. Par us raat woh sabse bada laga.

Aaj soch raha hoon — exam sirf bacchon ka nahi hai. Mera bhi hai. Agar yeh bacche fail hue, toh teacher kaun fail hua? Main. Priya pass hogi. Aman bhi. Par Raju? Raju mere haathon mein hai. Aur mere haath kaanp rahe hain.

episodes.synopsis: Board exams approaching. Sharma Sir's diary entries about how each kid handled pressure differently. His strategy for each. Priya's over-preparation worries him. Aman doesn't care. Raju is terrified.
episodes.caption: The night before the exam, 9 kids called their teacher. The one who didn't call? He was the one Sharma Sir should have worried about most. But that story comes later.

episodes.title: The Fight

slides.text: 18 March 2004. Aaj tuition mein kuch aisa hua jo maine kabhi expect nahi kiya tha. Raju ne Aman ko maara. Thappad nahi — mukka. Naak se khoon aaya. 15 saal ke bacche. Mere kamre mein. Meri nigrani mein.

Priya ne bataya kya hua. Aman ne Raju se kaha — 'Teri maa mere ghar mein jhaadu lagati hai. Tu yahan kya karega? Padh ke bhi jhaadu lagayega.' Sab bacche sun rahe the. Raju 5 second chup raha. Phir uthha. Aur Aman ki naak tod di.

Maine Aman ko daanta. Bahut daanta. Bola — 'Tere paas paisa hai, akal nahi. Teri aukat tujhe kisi ko neecha dikhane ka haq nahi deti.' Raju ko maine kuch nahi kaha. Usse ghar bheja. Main sochta raha — maine sahi kiya ya nahi?

Aman ke papa aaye. Bole — 'Sharma ji, aapka student mera beta maare?' Maine kaha — 'Jaiye police mein. Par pehle apne bete se puchiye usne kya kaha.' Woh chup hoke chale gaye. Raju ki maa aayi. Boli — 'Sir, maafi. Woh chhod dega tuition.' Maine kaha — 'Raju kahin nahi jayega.'

(Yeh entry 10 saal baad ki hai.) Aaj soch raha hoon — us din maine Aman ke saath galat kiya. Usne galat kaha. Par woh 15 saal ka tha. Usse samjhana tha, todna nahi tha. Main Aman pe isliye sakht tha kyunki mere andar ameer logon ke liye gussa tha. Woh gussa Aman ka nahi tha. Woh mera tha.

Raju ne Aman ko maara — yeh galat tha. Par maine Raju ko kuch nahi kaha — yeh bhi galat tha. Maine Raju ko hero banaya aur Aman ko villain. Par bacche villain nahi hote. Woh apne ghar ka aaina hote hain. Mera kaam aaina todna nahi tha. Saaf karna tha.

episodes.synopsis: Aman mocks Raju's mother being a maid. Raju punches him. Sharma Sir's diary reveals how he handled it — and how his bias against wealth clouded his judgment.
episodes.caption: A rich kid said something cruel. A poor kid threw a punch. The teacher took a side. 10 years later, he realized he was wrong. Not about the fight — about himself. Sharma Sir's diary doesn't spare anyone. Not even Sharma Sir.

episodes.title: The Last Class

slides.text: 15 May 2004. Aakhri class. Aaj ke baad yeh bacche nahi aayenge. 2 saal ho gaye. Roz shaam 5 se 7. Aaj 7 baj gaye. Koi nahi uthha. Main bhi nahi bola — 'Chalo, ghar jao.' Hum sab jaante the. Par kisi ne bola nahi.

Priya — IIT nikaal liya. Jaayegi Bombay. Aman — papa ka business. Raju — kuch nahi. Neha — arts college. Vikram — NDA. Sonal — medical. Deepak — 'Mumbai jaaunga, Sir. Actor banunga.' Ananya — law. Kabir — BA Urdu. Rahul — local college, BA.

Bacchon ne milke ek pen diya. Sasta pen. Parker ka duplicate. Par uspe likha tha — 'Sharma Sir — Best Teacher.' Galat spelling thi. 'Techer' likha tha. Deepak ki handwriting thi. Main hasa. Phir roya. Bathroom mein jaake roya. Bacchon ke saamne nahi.

Ek ek karke gaye. Priya ne pair chuye. Aman ne haath milaya — pehli baar uski aankhen naram thi. Raju gale laga. Zyada der tak. Maine usse dhakka deke hataya — nahi toh main phir ro deta. Neha ne kaha — 'Sir, ek din aapko meri photo exhibition dikhaungi.' Vikram ne salute kiya.

Rahul sabse last gaya. Bola — 'Sir, sab bhool jayenge. Main nahi bhoolunga. Phone karunga.' Maine hasa. Bola — 'Haan haan, sab yahi kehte hain.' Par Rahul ne sachmuch kiya. Har mahine phone karta tha. Jab tak... jab tak kar sakta tha.

Raat 9 baje kamra saaf kiya. Chatai pe chalk ke nishan. Ek pencil mili — Raju ki. Ek drawing mili — Neha ki. Ek chit mili — Deepak ne likhi thi: 'Sharma Sir = GOAT.' Yeh bacche 2 saal mere the. Ab pata nahi kab milein.
Diary mein us raat Sharma Sir ne sirf 4 shabd likhe: 'Aaj ghar khali ho gaya.'

episodes.synopsis: 12th board exams are done. The last tuition session. Kids are leaving for different futures. Sharma Sir's entry is the shortest and most painful one yet.
episodes.caption: 10 kids walked into Sharma Sir's house. 2 years later, they walked out. He thought they'd forget. Most of them did — for a while. But life has a way of bringing you back to the room where someone believed in you. The scattering begins tomorrow.

episodes.title: Priya — The Call From IIT

slides.text: 12 September 2004. Aaj Priya ka phone aaya. IIT Bombay se. Pehli baar. 4 mahine ho gaye. Phone pe uski awaaz aise thi jaise kisi ne andar se light bujha di ho.

'Sir, yahan sab tez hain. Main topper thi — yahan main average hoon. Class mein haath uthati hoon, galat jawab deti hoon. Log haste hain. Mujhe kuch nahi aata.' Yeh woh ladki bol rahi thi jisne 12th mein 97% laaye the.

Maine kaha — 'Priya, agar tu sabse tez rehna chahti hai, toh tu hamesha dukhi rahegi. Tera kaam tez hona nahi hai — seekhna hai.' Usne kaha — 'Par Sir, agar main first nahi hoon, toh main kya hoon?' Main chup ho gaya. Kyunki yeh sawaal maine hi toh khada kiya tha.

2 saal maine Priya ko kya sikhaya? First aao. Top karo. Best bano. Maine kabhi nahi kaha — 'Haar jao. Doosra number bhi theek hai.' Maine ek tez ladki ko aur tez banaya. Par khush nahi banaya. Ab woh IIT mein baithi hai — number ke bina toothi hui.

Raat ko neend nahi aayi. Priya 4 saal IIT mein rahegi. Phir Masters. PhD. America bhi ja sakti hai. Par kya woh kabhi khush hogi? Mujhe darr lag raha hai ki yeh ladki bahut door jaayegi — geography mein bhi, aur apne aap se bhi.

(15 saal baad.) Priya aaj America mein hai. Bada ghar. Badi salary. 6 saal se ghar nahi aayi. Uski maa ka phone aata hai — 'Sharma ji, kuch kahiye usse.' Main kya kahoon? Maine toh yahi sikhaya tha — sabse aage niklo. Woh nikli. Hum sab se.

episodes.synopsis: Priya's first phone call from IIT Bombay. She's struggling, not the top student anymore. Sharma Sir hears something that scares him — she doesn't know who she is without being first.
episodes.caption: She was the brightest student he ever taught. She went to IIT. Then America. The whole city was proud. Her teacher wasn't. Because he knew something nobody else did — he's the one who taught her that being first is everything. And now she can't stop running.

episodes.title: Aman — The Empire Falls

slides.text: 3 August 2006. Aman ki maa ka phone aaya. Aman ke papa ki tabiyat kharab hai. Business Aman chala raha hai. 22 saal ka ladka. Crores ka business. Maa boli — 'Sharma ji, woh kisi ki nahi sunta. Shayad aapki sune.'
Main gaya uske office. Office nahi — palace. Aman kursi pe baitha tha — 22 saal ka bachha, 50 saal wali kursi pe. Bola — 'Sir, sab control mein hai.' Uski aankhen kuch aur keh rahi thi.

Business 40% down. Aman ne 3 employees nikaal diye jo 20 saal se the. Naye logon ko laaya jo haan mein haan kehte hain. Wahi galti jo har naya raja karta hai — purane logon ko hatao, chamchon ko laao.

Maine Aman ko phone kiya. Bola — 'Aman, tu doob raha hai.' Woh gussa ho gaya. 'Sir, aap teacher hain. Business aapko nahi aata.' Maine kaha — 'Haan, business nahi aata. Par insaan padh leta hoon. Aur tu darr raha hai.' Line kat gayi.

Aman mujhse gussa hai. Shayad hamesha se tha. Us din — Raju wali fight — maine Aman ko villain banaya tha. Uske baad woh kabhi nahi aaya. Main teacher hoon — par kya har bacche tak pahunch paata hoon? Aman tak nahi pahuncha.
Aman aayega. Aaj nahi. Kal nahi. Par jab sab kuch tootega — tab aayega. Main intezaar karunga. Teacher ka kaam hai — intezaar karna.

episodes.synopsis: Aman's father falls ill, Aman takes over the family business at 22 with nothing but arrogance. Business starts failing. His mother calls Sharma Sir. Aman won't listen.
episodes.caption: The richest kid in the class took over a crore-rupee business at 22. No degree. No humility. Just ego. Sharma Sir tried to warn him. Aman hung up. But Sharma Sir knew — the phone would ring again. It always does. Just not when you expect it.

episodes.title: Vikram — The Soldier

slides.text: 22 December 2004. Vikram ka letter aaya. NDA clear ho gaya. Pune ja raha hai. Usne likha — 'Sir, finally ghar mil gaya.' Yeh line padhke khush bhi hua, dukhi bhi. Yeh ladka ghar dhundh raha tha. Use fauj mein mila.
Vikram kabhi late nahi hua. Ek din baarish mein aaya — bheega hua — par time pe. Maine kaha 'Ghar ja.' Bola — 'Sir, Papa kehte hain — weather excuse nahi hota.' 14 saal ka tha.

Rahul ne usse birthday party mein bulaya. Vikram ne gift mein compass diya — Papa ne Kargil se laaya tha. Rahul bola — 'Itna mehnga nahi chahiye tha.' Vikram bola — 'Pehli baar kisi ne birthday pe bulaya hai.'
Diary mein 2 shabd likhe: 'Garv. Darr.' Garv — kyunki yeh ladka kuch banega. Darr — kyunki army mein 'kuch banna' ka matlab hai ek din phone aa sakta hai — 'We regret to inform you.'

Vikram letter likhta tha — training mein phone nahi milta. Ek letter mein likha — 'Sir, yahan 200 log hain. Par jab thak jaata hoon, toh aapka kamra yaad aata hai. Woh chatai. Woh chalk ki smell. Woh 2 ghante.'

Vikram ab officer hai. Kashmir posting. Maa phone pe roti hai — 'Sharma ji, dua karo.' Diary mein likha — 'Yeh ladka darr nahi lagta. Yeh mujhe sabse zyada darata hai. Jo darr nahi lagta, woh bahut aage jaata hai. Wapas aana mushkil ho jaata hai.'

episodes.synopsis: Vikram clears NDA and joins the army. Sharma Sir feels pride and terror in equal measure. The disciplined boy finally found where he belongs.
episodes.caption: The loneliest boy in the class found a home in the Indian Army. His teacher wrote two words: Pride. Fear. Because when you send a student to the border, every news bulletin becomes personal. Vikram's toughest night hasn't come yet. But when it does, there's only one number he'll dial.

episodes.title: Neha — The Runaway

slides.text: 7 October 2006. Raat 12 baje Neha ke papa ka phone. 'Sharma ji, Neha ghar chhod ke chali gayi. Ek note chhoda — Papa, aapki duniya mein meri jagah nahi hai. Main apni duniya dhundh rahi hoon.'

Neha ke papa — strict aadmi. Ghar mein rule the — art 'timepass' hai. Neha ko doctor banana chahte the. Neha camera maangti thi. Papa ne kaha — 'Pehle padhai, phir timepass.' Neha ne padhai ki. Phir ghar chhod diya.

Maine bhi wahi kaha tha — 'Neha, drawing se kya hoga?' Main bhi uske papa jaisa tha — bas soft version. Agar maine ek baar bhi kaha hota — 'Yeh drawing achhi hai, Neha' — shayad woh itna door nahi jaati.

Neha Delhi gayi. Photography seekhne. PG mein — 4 ladkiyan ek kamre mein. Kabhi kabhi phone karti — 'Sir, bahut mushkil hai. Par main wapas nahi aaungi.' Uski aankhen mein woh cheez thi jo Priya mein nahi thi — woh jaanti thi KYA chahiye.

Neha ke papa mujhe phone karte hain — 'Woh theek hai?' Main beech mein hoon. Dono se jhooth bol raha hoon — 'Sab theek hoga.' Diary mein likha — 'Dono ek doosre se pyaar karte hain. Par kehne mein 10 saal lagenge.'

(10 saal baad.) Neha India ki top photographers mein se hai. National Geographic mein photo chhapi. Aur uske Papa ke bistar ke upar Neha ki photograph lagi hai. Unhone yeh Neha ko nahi bataya. Par mujhe pata hai.

episodes.synopsis: Neha leaves her strict father's home at 20 to pursue photography. Her father is devastated. Sharma Sir is caught in the middle — and realizes he contributed to this.
episodes.caption: She left home at 20 with a camera and a note. Her father didn't speak to her for years. But he kept her photograph above his bed. A daughter who wanted to be seen. A father who couldn't say he was looking. Sharma Sir saw both sides. His diary holds what neither could say.

episodes.title: Deepak — Dadar Station

slides.text: 19 January 2007. Deepak ka phone aaya. Background mein train ki awaaz. 'Tu kahan hai?' 'Sir, Dadar station. Yahan AC free hai.' Yeh ladka station pe so raha hai. Par uski awaaz mein hasi thi.
47 auditions. 0 roles. Ek ad mein extra — 2 second background mein. Photo bheja — 'Sir, dekho, TV pe aaya!' Maine dhundha — nahi mila. Usne circle karke bheja. 2 second ka sapna.

Deepak ke papa — chaat ka thela. Bole — 'Actor banega? Yahan pani puri bech.' Deepak ne kaha — 'Papa, aapki pani puri best hai. Par mera kaam alag hai.' Papa ne 500 rupaye diye. 'Jaa. Par wapas aana padhe toh sharam mat karna.'

Deepak roya phone pe. Pehli baar. 'Sir, ek director ne kaha — tera face hero wala nahi hai. Tu kuch nahi hai.' Maine kaha — 'Deepak, tu class mein bhi kuch nahi tha marks mein. Par tere bina class mein zindagi nahi thi. Tera kaam kamre mein zindagi laana hai.'

5 minute baad hasa. 'Sir, Dadar station pe ek uncle roz aate hain. 6 saal se. Unhe lagta hai Shah Rukh Khan train se aayega.' Maine kaha — 'Tu bhi deewana hai.' 'Haan Sir. Par main funny deewana hoon.' Station pe so raha hai. Par hasaa raha hai.

Diary mein likha — 'Deepak star nahi banega. Par kuch toh banega — kyunki yeh tootta nahi. Aaj Dadar station pe hasa. Aur mujhe bhi hasaya. Yeh kaafi hai.' (Entry ke end mein Sharma Sir ne smiley face banaya. 20 saal mein pehli baar. 'Deepak effect.')

episodes.synopsis: Deepak went to Mumbai to act. He's sleeping at Dadar station, getting rejected at auditions. His call to Sharma Sir is the funniest and saddest entry in the diary.
episodes.caption: He went to Mumbai to be a star. He slept at Dadar station. 47 auditions, zero roles. But when his teacher asked if he was okay, he told a joke. Some people don't break. They bend so far that one day, they become the bridge others walk on. Deepak's story isn't over.

episodes.title: Sonal — The Perfect Doctor

slides.text: 4 April 2009. Sonal ne MBBS complete kiya. Papa ka phone — 'Sharma ji, doctor ban gayi!' Maine bola — 'Bahut achha.' Diary mein likha — 'Sonal doctor ban gayi. Par kya Sonal khush hai? Yeh sawaal kisine nahi poocha. Maine bhi nahi.'
Ek din maine trick question diya. Sab hase. Sonal ro di — 'Sir, maine galat kiya.' Ek galat jawab pe rona — yeh normal nahi hai. Maine us din ignore kiya. Aaj regret hai.
Sonal phone karti — hamesha Sunday 10 baje. Same script. Ek baar poocha — 'Tu kaisi hai? TU.' 5 second chup rahi. Phir — 'Main bhi achhi hoon.' Woh 5 second — woh sab kuch tha.

School — parents ne chuna. College — parents ne chuna. Specialization — parents ne chuna. Shaadi bhi woh chunenge. Yeh ladki ne ek bhi decision nahi liya. 16 saal se dekh raha hoon. Ticking bomb hai. Par kya kahoon?

(2016.) Sonal ki maa — 'Sharma ji, hospital chhod diya. Kamre mein band hai. Depression. Hamari beti ko kya hua?' Diary mein — 'Sonal ko kuch nahi hua. 20 saal se ho raha tha. Maine dekha — par bola nahi. Yeh meri sabse badi galti hai.'

Maine dekha ki yeh bachhi toot rahi hai. 16 saal ki umar mein. Par kuch nahi kaha — marks achhe the. 'Problem kya hai?' Marks theek the. Bachhi nahi thi. Maine bhi kaha — 'Doctor bano.' Sonal, agar tu yeh padhe — I'm sorry. Tujhe ek baar puchna chahiye tha — TU kya banana chahti hai.

episodes.synopsis: Sonal becomes a doctor. Everyone celebrates. But Sharma Sir saw cracks at 16 — a girl who never said no, never had her own dream. At 32, she breaks.
episodes.caption: Perfect marks. Perfect behavior. Perfect career. Everyone celebrated. Her teacher didn't. He saw it 16 years ago — a girl who never said no was going to shatter. He was right. His biggest regret? He saw it coming and said nothing. Because the world rewards perfection. Until it doesn't.

episodes.title: Raju — The First Shop

slides.text: 11 November 2008. Aaj Raju ki dukaan gayi. Chhoti si — 8x10. Board pe — 'Raju Mobile Repair. All Company. Fast Service.' Spelling sab sahi thi. Maine check kiya.

Ek din kisi ka display toota. Raju ne YouTube se seekha. Fix kiya. 200 rupaye. Phir doosra. Teesra. Bola — 'Sir, padhai nahi aayi. Par haath mein hisaab hai. Cheezein theek karna aata hai.' Kaash maine yeh pehle dekha hota.
Chai mangwayi. Apni ek hi kursi mujhe di. Khud zameen pe baitha. 'Sir, aapke ghar pe bhi toh zameen pe baithta tha. Aadat hai.' Phir hasa. Us hasi mein koi dard nahi tha. Sirf khushi.
'Sir, maa ab kaam pe nahi jaati. Ab main kamata hoon. Maa se kaha — aaram karo.' Yeh ladka — jise sab slow kehte the — sabse pehle apni maa ko aaram de paaya. Na Priya ne. Na Aman ne. Raju ne.

Maine Raju ko underestimate kiya. Pehle din likha — 'Raju mushkil hoga.' Galat. Raju mushkil nahi tha. Mera system mushkil tha — jo sirf marks se naapata tha. Raju ko khushi mili. Woh sabse mushkil cheez hai.

Teacher ko favorite nahi rakhna chahiye. Par Raju mera favorite hai. Isliye nahi ki kamyaab hua. Isliye ki content hai. Bina comparison. Bina regret. Raju ne mujhe seekha diya — safalta ka matlab kya hai.

episodes.synopsis: Raju opens a small mobile repair shop. Sharma Sir visits and writes the proudest entry in the diary. The boy everyone underestimated found his way.
episodes.caption: He was the slowest student. No college. No degree. His mother was a maid. 10 years later, his mother doesn't work anymore. He has a shop, a wife, and a smile that never leaves. Sharma Sir wrote: 'I was wrong about Raju. I was wrong about everything.' Sometimes the slow ones win. Not the race — the life.

episodes.title: Kabir — The Wedding

slides.text: 2 February 2012. Kabir ki shaadi. Ladki ka naam Meera. Hindu hai. Dono ghar mein hungama. Kabir ne poocha — 'Sir, aap aaoge na?' Maine kaha — 'Main aaunga.' Phir phone rakha. Aur main bhi tense ho gaya.

Kabir ke abbu — 'Qaum chhod raha hai.' Meera ke papa — 'Izzat mitti mein mila di.' Dono taraf — 'Log kya kahenge?' Maine socha — woh log jinhe ek saal mein yaad bhi nahi rahega? Par yeh main diary mein likh sakta hoon. Kisi ke muh pe nahi.
Court marriage. Judge ke saamne. Kabir — safed kurta. Meera — peeli saree. Haath kaanp rahe the. Gawah — main. 4 log. Ek stamp. Na baarat. Na DJ. Par Kabir ki aankhen — woh sirf pyaar mein hoti hain.

Kabir bola — 'Sir, kuch kahiye.' Maine kaha — 'Tu poet hai. Log kahenge. Unke lafz chhote hain. Tere bade. Apni biwi ko roz sher sunana. Duniya ki problem hai.' Meera hasi. Kabir roi. Ulta tha. Par sahi tha.
Chhote sheher mein inter-faith shaadi — aag. Padosi ne baat band ki. Kabir bola — 'Sir, lagta hai galti ki.' Maine kaha — 'Galti tab hoti jab pyaar na hota. Pyaar hai — yeh sabse sahi cheez hai.'

(5 saal baad.) 'Sir, beta hua. Naam Sharma rakhna chahte hain. Aapke naam pe.' Main 5 minute bola nahi paaya. 'Aaj mera naam kisi bacche ka naam bana. Isse badi izzat kya hogi. Kabir — tu mera beta hai.'

episodes.synopsis: Kabir marries Meera — a Hindu girl. Both families resist. Sharma Sir attends as witness. The diary entry is full of warmth, conflict, and love that doesn't care about categories.
episodes.caption: A Muslim boy married a Hindu girl. Both families walked away. The only person at the court was their tuition teacher. 5 years later, they named their son after him. Not a trophy. Not an award. A child's name. That's what teaching gives you.

episodes.title: Ananya — The First Case

slides.text: 18 July 2011. Ananya ka phone. Ro rahi thi. 'Kya hua?' 'Sir, jeet gayi.' 'Toh ro kyun?' 'Sir, woh bachhi... woh main thi. 10 saal ki. Court mein. Mummy-papa ladte hue.'
12 saal ki thi jab divorce hua. Judge ne poocha — 'Mummy ke saath ya papa ke saath?' Usne maa choose ki. Papa ne maaf nahi kiya. Ananya ne khud ko maaf nahi kiya.
Tuition mein sabse zyada ladti thi. 'Itna gussa kyun?' 'Sir, practice hai. Duniya mein ladna padta hai. Mujhe koi nahi bachayega. Khud ko bachana hai.' 14 saal ki ladki. Main kuch nahi bol paaya.
Law isliye choose kiya kyunki court se nafrat thi. 'Sir, mujhe court ne tod diya. Ab main doosron ko todne nahi doongi.' Yeh healing hai. Apna dard kisi aur ke kaam laana — isse bada purpose kya?

8 saal ki ladki. Parents ladte hue. Ananya ne judge se kaha — 'Yeh bachhi property nahi hai. Choose karne se bachhe tootte hain. Main jaanti hoon. Main woh bachhi thi.' Court silent. Judge ne custody di — bina bachhi se pooché.
Case jeetke mujhe phone kiya. Papa ko nahi. Maa ko nahi. Mujhe. Diary mein — 'Shayad main woh ghar hoon jo uske paas kabhi nahi tha.' Ananya ka gussa — uski taaqat ban gaya. Dard shield ban gaya.

episodes.synopsis: Ananya wins her first custody case. She calls Sharma Sir in tears — the child she fought for reminded her of her own broken home.
episodes.caption: She fought her first custody case and won. She called her teacher, not her parents. Because her parents were the reason she became a lawyer. Some people turn wounds into weapons. Ananya turned hers into a shield — for every child on a courtroom bench being asked to choose.

episodes.title: Rahul

slides.text: 3 March 2008. Raat 11:30. Rahul ki maa. 'Sharma ji... Rahul...' Aur phir sirf rona. Maine samajh liya. Kuch sawaal hote hain jo poochne ki zaroorat nahi.
Road accident. Truck. Scooty. Ek second. 24 saal. Kal tak yeh bachha mere ghar mein baitha tha. Aaj uski maa mere ghar mein baithi hai.

Pehle din likha tha — 'Rahul. Average. Kuch special nahi.' Aaj woh page phadna chahta hoon. Woh sabse pehle Raju ke paas baitha. Sabse last class se gaya. Har mahine phone karta tha. Woh average nahi tha. Woh glue tha.

Shamshaan pe Aman tha — 4 saal baad. Priya phone pe royi — America se. Raju ne Rahul ki maa ka haath pakda poori raat. Neha ne camera rakh diya. Kuch cheezein capture nahi hoti. Vikram ka letter aaya — bheega hua.
Rahul har pehli taareekh ko phone karta tha. Ab har pehli taareekh main phone dekhta hoon. Pata hai nahi aayega. Phir bhi dekhta hoon. Aadat hai. Kuch aadatein todne mein zindagi lag jaati hai.
'Teacher ki sabse badi haar — student zinda na rahe.' Iske baad 3 page blank hain. Chauthe din likha — 'Rahul, tu average nahi tha. Tu zaroorat tha. Aur ab teri zaroorat hai — par tu nahi hai.'

episodes.synopsis: Rahul dies in a road accident at 24. The most devastating entry in the diary. The boy Sharma Sir called 'average' was the glue. Now the glue is gone.
episodes.caption: The average kid. Nothing special, his teacher wrote. But he checked on everyone. Called every month. Sat next to the lonely kid on day one. Was last to leave. Until he was first to go. Rahul was 24. The diary has 3 blank pages after his name. Sometimes silence says everything.

episodes.title: After Rahul

slides.text: April 2008. Ek mahina. Group silent. Pehle jokes, photos, 'kya haal hai.' Ab kuch nahi. Jaise Rahul ke saath baat karna bhi mar gaya. Ek doosre ko dekhte hain toh Rahul yaad aata hai. Toh dekhna band kar diya.

Aman — gussa. Priya — chup. Raju — roz Rahul ki maa ke ghar, tiffin le jaata hai. Neha — photos delete kar rahi hai. Vikram — baat nahi karta. Sonal — normal behave, jaise kuch hua nahi — sabse darr wali baat.

Ek mahine baad Deepak ne likha — 'Rahul hota toh kehta — tum log itne boring ho, isliye chala gaya.' Kisi ne reply nahi kiya. 2 ghante baad Raju ne 'haha' bheja. Phir Ananya. Deepak ne kamre mein zindagi layi. Chaahe kamra shamshaan ho.
Raju bola — 'Sir, Rahul window ke paas baithta tha. Agar hum aaye — woh jagah khali rehni chahiye.' Maine kaha — 'Hamesha khali rahegi.' Dono ro diye.
6 mahine baad. Priya ne group chhoda. Aman rarely online. Vikram — posting badli, connection nahi. Sirf Raju, Deepak, Kabir, Ananya connected. Rahul jo dhaaga tha — toot gaya.
'Rahul, tere bina yeh sab bikhar rahe hain. Tu average tha — par tere bina average bhi nahi raha. Sab below average ho gaya.'

episodes.synopsis: The group falls apart after Rahul's death. The WhatsApp group goes silent. Each student grieves differently. The bonds dissolve.
episodes.caption: After Rahul, the group went silent. Not because they didn't care — because caring hurt too much. Looking at each other meant seeing who wasn't there. Sharma Sir wrote: 'You were average, Rahul. But without you, even average is gone.' Some people are invisible until they're gone.
